given: A Workroom task (operation_type='workroom:<id>') is mid-flight; it has already persisted a staged_drafts row + GCS bundle before the orchestrator is recycled.
when: The orchestrator is killed and a replacement re-claims the meeting.
then: The recovery SQL completion check sees result_ref already points at the deliverable, so the coarse workroom:<id> unit is NOT re-run (idempotent restart-unless-deliverable); the staged draft survives the kill and remains acceptable post-call, and abort-is-final still holds for any killed build.
